# Risks and open questions

## Risks

| id | title | L | I | status | evidence | mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `risk.ci-budget` | Private CI minutes stop Core delivery | high | high | open | tastile-core: every run since 2026-09-26 17:06 UTC failed with 0 steps (Actions budget $2 cap) | Core heavy CI → Cloud Build (ADR-0020, poc.cloud-build-ci); private blogs repo の失敗 workflow を停止。 |
| `risk.undetected-regression` | Regressions merge while CI cannot run | high | high | open | 3 failing Core tests on the release line found only by local run (poc.core-suite-vanilla-pg) | merge 前 gate を CI 可用性に依存させない (local full gate evidence を PR に添付、ADR-0020)。 |
| `risk.db-tier` | db-f1-micro has no SLA and 25 connections | medium | medium | accepted | Cloud SQL pricing page (shared-core not covered by SLA) | pre-launch SLO を 99.5% に置く。CPU > 60% (1h)・connection > 80%・post-launch のいずれかで db-g1-small または dedicated 1 vCPU へ上げる。 |
| `risk.gcp-lock-in` | Platform lock-in to GCP | medium | medium | accepted |  | OCI image、vanilla PostgreSQL、HTTP 起動 worker、標準 JWT / OAuth のみを contract にする。Cloud Run 固有 API を core code に入れない。 |
| `risk.cutover-data` | Data loss or long downtime during AWS → GCP cutover | medium | high | open |  | product freeze 中に pg_dump / restore rehearsal を staging で 2 回、production は告知付き maintenance window (≤ 30 分) で実施。rollback は DNS を AWS に戻す (cutover 後 7 日間 AWS を停止のみで保持)。 |
| `risk.solo-operator` | Single operator (bus factor 1) | high | high | accepted |  | 全手順を repository の runbook と IaC にし、会話履歴に依存しない (本 SoT)。agent は staging までの authority。 |
| `risk.email-deliverability` | Auth email cannot reach users | medium | high | open | AWS SES production access was denied; SES sandbox only delivers to verified addresses | poc.email-provider を公開前 gate にする。 |
| `risk.cloudflare-limits` | Cloudflare Free / Workers Free limits | medium | low | accepted |  | 100k requests/day 超過前に Workers Paid ($5)。nested hostname を使わない (environments.yaml)。 |
| `risk.edge-bypass` | Direct run.app access bypasses WAF | medium | medium | open |  | cred.edge-assertion を production / staging middleware で必須化。app 側 auth / rate limit は常に有効。 |
| `risk.bridge-secret` | Web bridge secret grants all-user impersonation | low | critical | open |  | ADR-0016 (JWT assertion) を cutover 前に完了。 |
| `risk.cli-distribution` | CLI has no binary distribution | high | low | open |  | GitHub Release に cross-compiled binary + checksum を publish する release workflow を追加。 |
